commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a file, function or the whole project
commands.prompt: Explain {args} to a new teammate: purpose, main flow, key functions, gotchas. Read the code first; do not guess. Do not edit files.

commands.name: docs
commands.prompt: Write clear documentation for {args}: docstrings/comments only where the codebase uses them, plus a README section if appropriate. Match existing style. Do not change behaviour.

commands.name: init
commands.prompt: Explore this project and create a CODER.md in the project root that tells an AI coding assistant: what the project is, how to build/run/test it (verify the commands by running them), folder layout, code conventions, and pitfalls. Keep it under 80 lines.
